items.title: DoorDash (DASH) Shares Dropped, So What Is Driving Attention Now?
items.summary: DoorDash (DASH) is back in focus after agreeing to buy Wonder’s Grubhub Campus Dining unit for $300 million and investing $125 million in Wonder. This move reshapes its presence in higher education ordering. DoorDash shares have eased in the near term, with the 30-day share price return down 8.6% and the stock also declining year to date.
